title: Austin Housing: Mortgage Bond Decisions
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation Board convened to address financial strategies for local housing programs.
*   A key resolution involved approving the sale of new mortgage-backed securities.
*   Funds from these new securities were authorized to redeem (pay off) Single-Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds from 1997.
*   This financial move aimed to refinance or restructure the city's older housing program debt.
transcript:
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
The Austin Housing Finance Corporation, Board of Directors, 
will convene at 3:00 PM on Thursday, August 04, 2011, 
in Council Chambers at Austin City Hall, 301 W. Second Street, Austin, Texas 
 
 
AGENDA 
The Board of Directors will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code to receive advice from legal counsel, to 
discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda. If 
necessary, the Board may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.  
 
Approval of Minutes 
 
1. 
Approve the minutes of the May 12, 2011 Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation. 
 
Consent 
 
2. 
Approve a resolution authorizing the sale of mortgage-backed securities relating to Austin Housing Finance 
Corporation Single-Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds Series 1997, and the subsequent redemption of Austin 
Housing Finance Corporation Single-Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds Series 1997, and other related matters. 
 
Adjourn

inform the City Clerk’s staff present at the council meeting.
